paragraphs.text: Yukora (YOO-koh-rah) , the Prisoner , is a oni kami of kamigawa .

Several decades before the Kami War , a group of 99 powerful kannushi monks magically imprisoned Yukora due to his terrifying and murderous nature towards mortals. However, upon the death of the ninety-nine, the spell that sealed him was broken, and the oni was able to return to the mortal world seeking vengeance for its imprisonment. He appeared as a grey-skinned, three-eyed humanoid with two large horns. The spell caused him to be covered in chains that pierced into his skin.
